If you want to learn, don't get private lessons- save that for later if you want to up your game. Instead, sign up for a tennis clinic- call a nearby country club to see if they'll let you take the clinic without being a member- some allow this. Clinics cost anywhere from $5 to $15 a class and you'll usually be with a group of around a dozen people. This is a good method because you're with people who share a similar skill level and you're also meeting people you can hit with.

Once you learn how to serve and learn the rules and have been hitting for six months or so, find the USTA website and get yourself rated. You will hit with a pro and they'll decide what level you are- a beginner is usually around a 3.0 or so. There's a fee to get rated but I don't know how much it is. Once you're rated, you can join a league and then play all over town (even at all the beautiful country club courts!). This is also a great way to meet neat people- and playing mixed doubles is a fun double date.
